title: Onboarding: the first week, the first commit and the first on-call shift

videos.script: Before Renata, new engineers at Caju spent their first two days waiting. For a laptop, an email account, access to the code. {{title}} Lucas starts on a Monday. At nine his laptop works. By three, a real bug from a clinic is in his hands. {{monday}} On Thursday his fix reaches production, and the clinic that reported it says thank you. {{thursday}} This lesson is about that week, and the month before it. A list, a buddy with time to do it, and a first task chosen in advance. {{list}} About a plan for the first three months, with something anybody can check at each stage. {{plan}} And about the first on-call shift, built in steps, so nobody is alone at three in the morning with an alert they do not understand. {{oncall}}
